[package]
name = "mitsuami"
description = "Native, declarative, cross-platform UI for Rust"
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
authors = ["David Rios <david.rios.gomes@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/Roboport-Tecnologia/mitsuami"
homepage = "https://mitsuami.roboport.com.br"
readme = "../../README.md"
exclude = ["examples/files/msix"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "aarch64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[features]
default = ["gtk"]
gtk = ["dep:mitsuami-gtk"]
kde = ["dep:mitsuami-kirigami", "mitsuami-kirigami/qt"]

[dependencies.mitsuami-core]
path = "crates/mitsuami-core"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dependencies.mitsuami-reactive]
path = "crates/mitsuami-reactive"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dependencies.mitsuami-widgets]
path = "crates/mitsuami-widgets"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dependencies.mitsuami-macros]
path = "crates/mitsuami-macros"
version = "=1.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.mitsuami-appkit]
path = "crates/mitsuami-appkit"
version = "=1.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.mitsuami-gtk]
optional = true
path = "crates/mitsuami-gtk"
version = "=1.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.mitsuami-kirigami]
optional = true
path = "crates/mitsuami-kirigami"
version = "=1.0.0"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.mitsuami-winui]
path = "crates/mitsuami-winui"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dev-dependencies.mitsuami-test]
path = "crates/mitsuami-test"
version = "=1.0.0"

[[test]]
name = "counter"
harness = false

[package]
name = "mitsuami-appkit"
description = "AppKit (macOS) backend for mitsuami"
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
authors = ["David Rios <david.rios.gomes@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/Roboport-Tecnologia/mitsuami"
homepage = "https://mitsuami.roboport.com.br"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
default-target = "aarch64-apple-darwin"

[dependencies.mitsuami-core]
path = "crates/mitsuami-core"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dependencies.mitsuami-widgets]
path = "crates/mitsuami-widgets"
version = "=1.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6"
objc2-foundation = "0.3"
objc2-core-foundation = "0.3"
objc2-game-controller = "0.3"
block2 = "0.6"
dispatch2 = "0.3"
objc2-uniform-type-identifiers = "0.3"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3"
features = ["objc2-uniform-type-identifiers"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-quick-look-thumbnailing]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "QLThumbnailGenerator", "QLThumbnailGenerationRequest", "QLThumbnailRepresentation", "bitflags", "block2", "objc2-app-kit", "objc2-core-foundation"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dev-dependencies.mitsuami-reactive]
path = "crates/mitsuami-reactive"
version = "=1.0.0"

[[test]]
name = "services"
harness = false

[lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"
missing_debug_implementations = "allow"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "warn"
priority = -1

[package]
name = "mitsuami-core"
description = "Node tree, layout, styles, units, a11y model and backend contract for mitsuami"
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
authors = ["David Rios <david.rios.gomes@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/Roboport-Tecnologia/mitsuami"
homepage = "https://mitsuami.roboport.com.br"

[dependencies]
taffy = "0.14"
raw-window-handle = "0.6"
unicode-segmentation = "1.13"
fluent-bundle = "0.16"
unic-langid = "0.9"
intl-memoizer = "0.5"

[dependencies.mitsuami-reactive]
path = "crates/mitsuami-reactive"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dependencies.fluent-langneg]
version = "0.13"
features = ["cldr"]

[lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"
missing_debug_implementations = "allow"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "warn"
priority = -1

[dependencies.mitsuami-widgets]
path = "crates/mitsuami-widgets"
version = "=1.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.adw]
package = "libadwaita"
version = "0.9"
features = ["v1_4"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.gtk]
package = "gtk4"
version = "0.11"
features = ["v4_10"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.mitsuami-linux]
path = "crates/mitsuami-linux"
version = "=1.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dev-dependencies.mitsuami-reactive]
path = "crates/mitsuami-reactive"
version = "=1.0.0"

[[test]]
name = "services"
harness = false

[lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"
missing_debug_implementations = "allow"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "warn"
priority = -1

[package]
name = "mitsuami-kirigami"
description = "Qt Quick and Kirigami (KDE Plasma) backend for mitsuami"
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
authors = ["David Rios <david.rios.gomes@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/Roboport-Tecnologia/mitsuami"
homepage = "https://mitsuami.roboport.com.br"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["qt"]

[features]
qt = ["dep:mitsuami-linux"]

[dependencies.mitsuami-core]
path = "crates/mitsuami-core"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dependencies.mitsuami-widgets]
path = "crates/mitsuami-widgets"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dependencies.mitsuami-linux]
optional = true
path = "crates/mitsuami-linux"
version = "=1.0.0"

[dev-dependencies.mitsuami-reactive]
path = "crates/mitsuami-reactive"
version = "=1.0.0"

[build-dependencies]
cc = "1.2"
pkg-config = "0.3"

[[test]]
name = "services"
harness = false
required-features = ["qt"]

[lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"
missing_debug_implementations = "allow"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "warn"
priority = -1

[package]
name = "mitsuami-linux"
description = "GpuSurface on Linux for mitsuami's GTK and Kirigami backends: a Wayland subsurface or an X11 child window, pointer locks and a shortcuts inhibitor"
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
authors = ["David Rios <david.rios.gomes@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/Roboport-Tecnologia/mitsuami"
homepage = "https://mitsuami.roboport.com.br"

[dependencies.mitsuami-core]
path = "crates/mitsuami-core"
version = "=1.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies]
wayland-client = "0.31"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.wayland-backend]
version = "0.3"
features = ["client_system", "dlopen"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.wayland-protocols]
version = "0.32"
features = ["client", "unstable"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.x11rb]
version = "0.13"
features = ["allow-unsafe-code", "dl-libxcb", "shape", "xinput"]

[lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"
missing_debug_implementations = "allow"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "warn"
priority = -1

[package]
name = "mitsuami-macros"
description = "view! and #[component] for mitsuami"
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
authors = ["David Rios <david.rios.gomes@gmail.com>"]
repository = "https://github.com/Roboport-Tecnologia/mitsuami"
homepage = "https://mitsuami.roboport.com.br"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
proc-macro2 = "1"
quote = "1"
fluent-syntax = "0.12"
unic-langid = "0.9"

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2"
features = ["full"]

[lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"
missing_debug_implementations = "allow"

[lints.clippy.all]
level = "warn"
priority = -1
